activities.description: Chaos Dwarf Lord sits on a throne of debris as the army marches through a ruined city.
The army marches towards a massive, burning industrial complex.
Molten metal is poured into a mold while dwarfs work in the forge.
The Chaos Dwarf Forge Master hammers a glowing weapon at an anvil.
The army gathers around a crucible as a massive, fiery figure emerges.
The fiery figure transforms into a powerful Chaos Dwarf Lord with a massive weapon.

text_to_speech: Forsaken. Abandoned to the Dark. What choice but to follow the flame? A fire to tear down the old ways. Burning away all fear, doubt… ...and weakness. Nothing remains but power and ambition. This roaring fire will always demand more. More Fuel. More Sacrifice. The fiercest heat to forge the hardest steel. Destiny rising from within the crucible. To seize the world with this fire… is to see it... burn first.
